Lead.description:
One lead surfaced by a survey.

The shape is the catalog lead minus the envelope `source` key,
which the orchestrator stamps. Doubles as the item shape of the
generated `survey` judgment-answer schema.

focus.description:
Source-local focus that produced this lead. Absent on an
unfocused import or survey row.

lead.description:
Stable kebab-case lead identifier, unique only within its
source; identity is the `(source, lead)` pair.

parent.description: Parent lead id within the same source. Absent on a top-level lead.

topics.description:
Agent-authored per-lead topic slugs (kebab-case). Empty means
unclassified.

description: Generated judgment-answer schema — generated from the Rust wire types by project::answers; do not edit. Validates the schema-gated answer to a source adapter's survey operation: an object carrying `leads[]` (unfocused) and `children[]` (focused), each item the lead shape minus the envelope `source` key (the caller attributes every lead to the surveyed source). Lead ids and topic slugs carry the kebab-case grammar in-schema and are re-checked deterministically after the gate, alongside the trim-aware synopsis check the schema cannot express.

children.description: Stable child leads under a focused parent.

leads.description: Top-level leads from an unfocused survey, in source order.

title: Emery survey answer
